about_the_game:
Are you a Thief or a Guard? Choose your side and try to outsmart your opponents with your plans! Use your role, watch your surroundings, and wait for the right moment — but be careful, your time is limited! What you do within the time limit will determine your fate. Remember, only one side wins the game!

Steal as many valuables as you can before time runs out, stay low-key, and escape without getting caught by the guard!

Every bandit shares a common ability: Disguise! Blend into the crowd and act like one of them. If you’re spotted, use your skills to escape! 

Remember, You are a team! Each of you has a unique role — create the right combos as a team and confuse the guard!

As the Guard, you have one mission: Protect the Treasure!

The king has already called in the troops, and the thieves are on a timer. Your goal is to stop the heist within this limited time and, if possible, capture the thieves! But be careful — harming innocents can have irreversible consequences!

Choose your role wisely! Each role has unique abilities and strategies. Pick the role that best suits your playstyle and prevent the thieves from escaping!

This adventure, which begins in the medieval era, is about to expand with brand-new themes! Different eras, different locations. Who knows when and where the thieves will strike next?

  • A Variety of Roles to Diversify the Gameplay!

  • Thieves Don’t Have Ten Hands: Inventory Management!

  • Guard-Exclusive Emergency Mechanic!

  • New Themes, New Maps! (Coming Soon!)

  • Heists at Different Times! (How About a Night Heist?)

  • Team Play for Thieves!

  • Stealth and Strategy-Focused Gameplay

  • Replayability

short_description: 4 Thieves vs. 1 Guardian! A medieval heist game! Play as a thief, disguise yourself among the crowd, and steal the treasure, or take on the role of the guardian and hunt down the thieves! Everyone has a unique role and strategy. Find the right approach and lead your team to victory!
